quality.content:
*   **Long-Context Retention:** Evaluates the model's ability to maintain focus on specific data points buried within a massive volume of repetitive filler text without losing track of the core subject matter.
*   **Deterministic Retrieval Accuracy:** Tests whether the system can precisely locate and extract unique alphanumeric identifiers from a noisy environment, ensuring no hallucinations or omissions occur during extraction.
*   **Noise Resistance & Attention Span:** Measures how well the model filters out irrelevant, repeated technical descriptions to prevent context window saturation or degradation of reasoning capabilities due to redundant input.
*   **Instruction Adherence Under Load:** Verifies that the model can follow complex formatting constraints (concise bullets, specific listing order) even when processing a document designed to stress-test memory bandwidth and cache reuse limits.
*   **Structural Consistency Check:** Assesses if the output remains logically structured and non-repetitive despite the input containing hundreds of identical lines, ensuring the model distinguishes between signal (markers) and noise (filler).
